title: The tumor suppressor MIR139 is silenced by POLR2M to promote AML oncogenesis
model: Mouse MLL-AF9 leukemia cells (wild-type and Mir139-knockout), mouse GeCKOv2 A+B knockout library
contrast: Wild-type vs Mir139-KO MLL-AF9 cells, day 14 (1 vs 1, no replicates); also WT day 14 vs 24 h
paper_method: Guides lost >=10-fold per gene (Supplementary Table 6) plus a permutation gene table
paper_calls: 16 genes with 5-6 guides lost >=10-fold; Polr2m validated (neg-FDR 0.46 in their own table)
barcs_calls: 8 genes at FDR 0.10 WT vs KO, mostly single-guide jackpots in the KO library, screening-level; 10 enriched genes (Bag6, Pmaip1, Bcl2l11, Bax) WT d14 vs 24 h
named_hits: 0/1: Polr2m rank 1,163, p = 0.18; Men1, Rbbp4, Eed (d14 vs 24 h) ranks 695-1,833, not called
verdict: BARCS does not call Polr2m or the paper's other guide-count picks: the day-14 libraries are bottlenecked, and BARCS's own WT-vs-KO calls are single-clone jackpots. Only the enrichment of pro-apoptotic knockouts (Pmaip1, Bcl2l11, Bax, Bag6) over time is clean.
